title: The Last Mystery
author: Colin Sanders, Andrew Greenhill, Garrett Dowdy, Chris Ormstrup, Megan Hollowell
description: This was a project for my freshman-year English class in 2013.  The other authors primarily contributed to the writing and story flow while I took on most of the programming. I uncovered it going through some old hard drives. Make sure to turn your volume on to feel appropriately unsettled. The story feels a bit cliché after all these years. Apologies for any "gotcha" commands; I didn't know any better at the time.
